title: Oven Roasted Smoky Russian White Bread Tagine
description: A smoky, springy, plant-based Russian dish featuring white bread mix, perfect for a brunch mood, cooked in a tagine pot. This recipe combines the flavors of Russia with the convenience of a one-pot meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the white bread mix, water, smoked paprika, and olive oil, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a tagine pot, covering it with a lid.
Bake the bread for 25 minutes, then remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
While the bread is baking, heat a skillet over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Once the bread is done, remove it from the oven and top it with the mushroom and onion mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the smoky Russian white bread tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
